verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a policy or control that stops user data from being used to train AI models. The closest material is local mode, which keeps agent state on-device. That is a separate data-residency capability that says nothing about training use, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: all agent state, including messages, memory, and provider connections, stays on-device, and no Letta account is required.
